bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (screenshot markup editor, shell-only); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (drawing app); springboard/sdk/src/glyphs.rs (pencil glyph only); pure models in springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs, lasso.rs, handwriting.rs and scribble.rs; no PencilKit-shaped type in springboard/sdk/src; built on parity/team-j-pencilkit; not yet verified on Midget
summary: BifrOSt has two working drawing surfaces: the shell's screenshot markup editor (pen, marker, pencil, eraser, undo, PNG save) and the Freeform app (pen, marker, eraser, palette, undo, PNG save). Neither is exposed to apps through the SDK. The ui crate holds pure models for a stroke and drawing data model with a text save format, stroke-level erasing, lasso selection, handwriting line segmentation with a recogniser hook, and Scribble gesture resolution. No shell or app calls those models yet, and there is no handwriting recogniser, no pressure input from a device, and no SDK canvas view.

features.feature: Canvas view capturing pen and finger input
features.note: Both capture Down/Move/Up touch events and stamp strokes onto a pixel buffer. The markup editor's touch path is tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05.rs: a press stamps a dot, a drag inks a line, and touches outside the picture draw nothing. No SDK view class, no low-latency pen path, and no separate pen input. Apps cannot embed a canvas. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Drawing model (PKDrawing) and save as data
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs; wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/sketch.rs (save, load; <id>-<n>.sketch beside the picture)
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-pencilkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The stroke list lives inside the shell and is not serialised. Both editors save a flattened PNG only (markup.rs Done, Freeform save to the screenshot directory). A drawing cannot be reopened as strokes. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by ui drawing.rs (Drawing::to_text and from_text round-trip); tests drawing::tests.

features.feature: Stroke and point model (PKStroke, PKStrokePath, PKStrokePoint)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs (Stroke, StrokePoint, Stroke::slice, Stroke::resampled, Stroke::blend, Drawing::bounds); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/sketch.rs (Pad, stroke_dabs)
features.note: The drawing model keeps each point's time offset, size, opacity, force, azimuth and altitude, and slices, resamples and blends strokes by arc length; verified headless by the headless_* tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. The shell and the sketch pad still stamp x,y points only, and there is no SDK path object. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs (Ink, InkKind, Drawing::to_text, Drawing::from_text); springboard/ui/src/markup_ink.rs (InkTool, InkCanvas)
features.note: Each stroke carries an ink with a kind, packed colour and width; InkCanvas captures pen, marker, pencil and eraser gestures with per-tool width and opacity. Headless tests cover the canvas and drawing model. The shell editor and sketch pad still keep their own stroke state, and no pressure-sensitive ink catalogue is built. Midget verification remains open.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/tool_picker.rs (ToolPicker: tool set, selection, colour and width per inking tool, visibility); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05b.rs; springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:27 (TOOLS) and the colour row; springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (palette)
features.note: ToolPicker (re-exported by the SDK) holds the tool set, selection, colour and width of each inking tool, and is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05b.rs. The markup editor and Freeform do not use it yet, and no view attaches a picker to a canvas, so each editor draws its own tool and colour row. Refreshed 2026-10-17: SDK re-exports ui tool_picker (bifrost_sdk::tool_picker); tests tool_picker::tests.

features.feature: Pen, marker, pencil and eraser tools (PKInkingTool, PKEraserTool)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/markup_ink.rs (InkTool, InkCanvas); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:20 (four tools); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:183 (four tools, lasso and shapes)
features.note: InkCanvas models the four tools, captures pointer gestures and erases touched strokes; the shell and Freeform editors still keep separate state and do not call it. Headless tests cover the model. No pressure input is supplied, and Midget verification remains open.

The loop's even-odd hit test (concave loops included), stroke selection, selection bounds, and moving or scaling the selected strokes are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05b.rs. Freeform imports the model for its lasso tool. The selection outline and handles belong to the shell and apps and are not part of the model; not yet verified on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/undo.rs (UndoManager, register, undo, redo); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:215 (undo, rebuilds canvas from base and remaining strokes); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/mod.rs (Undo zone) to sketch.rs Pad::undo
features.note: The UI undo model (register, undo, redo, and a new edit clearing the redo history) is verified headless over a Drawing in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. The shell editor has stroke-level undo with no redo, and the drawing editors are not yet wired to the UI undo model. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: PKStroke init from path data, Bezier import article
features.note: Drawing::from_path makes one stroke per subpath, flattening curves to points within a tolerance; the shape and the subpath split are tested in the drawing unit tests. Gap: a stroke keeps only points, so imported curves are not kept as curves, and the shell does not import paths yet.

features.apple: Controlling stroke rendering for animation and editing
features.note: Stroke::slice, resampled and blend cut and interpolate strokes by arc length, tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. Gap: there is no time-based animation driver, and the shell and sketch pad do not animate or blend strokes yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/handwriting.rs (segment_lines, recognize_lines, Recognizer trait); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs; no recogniser implementation; built on parity/team-j-pencilkit; not yet verified on Midget
features.note: Line layout is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs: strokes group into lines by vertical overlap (a_tall_stroke_joins...), lines read top to bottom and strokes left to right (the_recogniser_is_handed...), and lines the recogniser refuses are left out (lines_the_recogniser_refuses...). No letter recognition exists in BifrOSt, so an app or the shell must supply a Recognizer. Not wired into the shell or apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/scribble.rs (classify, resolve: tap, scratch-out and write targets); built on parity/team-j-pencilkit; not yet verified on Midget
features.note: Gesture model only: a short stroke is a tap, a tight zigzag is a scratch-out, anything else is writing for the view under its centre. The classification and target resolution are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07-w7.rs. Input routing into text fields and rendering are not built. Not wired into the shell or apps.

The stylus force sets each point's width through pressure_width, and a point's opacity scales its paint, both tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-15.rs. Gap: tilt (azimuth, altitude) does not change the rendered mark, and Markup and Freeform still send only position on touch events, so the shell has no pressure to pass on yet. Refreshed 2026-10-17: ui stylus.rs maps raw pressure and tilt onto StrokePoint force, altitude and azimuth; tests stylus::tests. The shell and Freeform still read touch only.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs (Drawing::image, Raster); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (Done saves the marked-up PNG over the capture); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (saves a PNG); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/sketch.rs (render, encode)
features.note: Drawing::image renders the strokes to a raster at a chosen scale with source-over blending, pressure-scaled width and per-point opacity, verified pixel by pixel headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs and springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-15.rs. Marker blend modes are not rendered yet, and no SDK call exposes the render. Both editors write PNG files. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.
Depends on PencilKit's ink format versions. BifrOSt has no drawing format to version.

gaps: No app-facing canvas view: the drawing model and tool picker are re-exported by the SDK (bifrost_sdk::drawing, bifrost_sdk::tool_picker), but no SDK view captures strokes into a drawing for an app window.
Shell and Freeform save flattened PNG only; Drawing::to_text and from_text (ui drawing.rs) give a serialised format they do not use yet.
No handwriting recogniser: the line layout and Recognizer hook exist in springboard/ui/src/handwriting.rs, but nothing recognises letters.
No Scribble input path into text fields: the gesture model exists in springboard/ui/src/scribble.rs, but nothing routes stylus strokes to views.
Stylus input: ui stylus.rs maps pressure and tilt onto stroke points, but the shell and Freeform only read touch position.
The tool picker is re-exported by the SDK (bifrost_sdk::tool_picker), but no app can attach it to a canvas; the markup tools stay private to the shell.
The shell markup editor (springboard/src/shell/markup.rs) and the Freeform app each keep their own stroke code, so they do not use the shared ui drawing module.
